notes: This minor release adds bifrost.python-performance-summaries 1.0.0 to the native recipe: reviewed CPython 3.13.5 declared performance effects for time.sleep, subprocess.run, pickle.dumps and pickle.loads (one-argument and full-signature forms), builtins sorted and list.sort, buffered reads, sqlite3 Cursor.execute and http.client HTTPConnection.request, which the Python arms of the rules 0.5.0 bifrost.performance loop policies read. The pack envelope is complete, matching its complete summaries, as the pinned producer requires. The source catalog also extends the CPython 3.13.5 runtime-base model with unittest.TestCase, MutableMapping and threading.Thread ancestry and adds declared performance effects to the CPython golden and Python security-sink summary sources; the recipe does not select those, so they are source additions, not native additions. Every other job and recipe and the Bifrost 0.14.0 generator are unchanged from 0.5.0. Fresh generation, artifact integrity, per-run completeness and consumer behavior remain separate qualification requirements.
